import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not data:
        return
    
    # Parse input: p=[2,3,1],k=1
    # Find p=[...] part
    p_start = data.find('p=')
    p_end = data.find(']', p_start)
    p_str = data[p_start+2:p_end+1]
    p = [int(x) for x in p_str.split(',')]
    
    # Find k= value
    k_start = data.find('k=')
    k_end = data.find('\n', k_start)
    if k_end == -1:
        k_str = data[k_start+2:]
    else:
        k_str = data[k_start+2:k_end]
    k = int(k_str)
    
    n = len(p)
    if n == 0:
        print('[]')
        return
    
    # Convert to 0-indexed
    p = [x - 1 for x in p]
    
    # Binary lifting table
    LOG = 60  # Since k can be up to 1e18
    up = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOG)]
    up[0] = p[:]
    
    for j in range(1, LOG):
        for i in range(n):
            up[j][i] = up[j-1][up[j-1][i]]
    
    # Compute result for each position
    result = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        pos = i
        remaining = k
        for j in range(LOG-1, -1, -1):
            if remaining >= (1 << j):
                pos = up[j][pos]
                remaining -= (1 << j)
        result[i] = pos + 1 # 1-indexed
    
    print('[' + ','.join(map(str, result)) + ']')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
